name: Raz Gupta
source: Born March 6, 212 FE, in Goa, India, UPR. A brilliant and deadly mecha pilot for the UPR military, charged with one of the most advanced mechs in the solar system, the cobalt-colored Benzai. Has felled many pilots, including other Melchior units.
